lenses.assessment: Keep typed property/building/opening and support elevation through the gate projection, scene descriptor and review transform. Actual native visibility owner remains separate prior evidence.
SceneBuildingId, OpeningAssemblyId, GateDatum, SupportElevation and SceneDoorPose each own different facts; numeric equality does not establish alias.
Current input validator checks each distant list for nonzero/unique IDs, while helper lacks its own admission. Finite SupportElevation internal construction remains a bounded open question.
Typed support conversion preserves finite scalar on the shown path; coordinate composition and fallible collider/leaf conversions remain independently owned.
Door identity, paired pose and native transform, boundary scene/elevation and building/collider/sign publication form related aggregates; no atomic command guarantee inferred.
City property identity and SceneBuildingId are distinct; gate namespace producer and presentation consumer policy needs source evidence before redesign.
SceneDoorPose owns paired source leaf/native rotation; current viewer reads both together. ReviewLeafPose is a derived presentation copy, not proven competing authority.
P16 GateDatum::from_metres is replaced by current typed new; same finite scalar under inspected constructors but no whole-product or nonfinite reachability equivalence claimed.
OpeningPose controls explicit open/closed review states; no bogus boolean state identified in assigned body.
Assigned functions use native descriptors and no handwritten serialization implementation. Separate owner serialization policies remain outside this role.
Support elevation, gate-relative and scene positions, native quaternion and typed door leaf have distinct frame/representation roles.
Formatted Tactical building Name is a display label, not inspected business dispatch. The setup expect string is a human panic message; rule mismatch is about expect, not a private string protocol.
Gate tag and raw property bits are existing q2238 namespace concerns. No blanket numeric replacement or unsupported collision claim.
